fact_previews: bbPress Notify Pro for WordPress is an evolution of the popular bbPress Notify (no-spam) plugin.
Vinny Alves is the creator of bbPress Notify Pro for WordPress.
The project was launched on Kickstarter with a funding goal of $1,977.
The project funding was unsuccessful as the goal was not reached by January 12, 2015.
The funding period for the project was from December 13, 2014, to January 12, 2015.

Messages can contain an opt-out link, inserted into the template by a shortcode.

Admins can specify to which forums users are allowed to subscribe.
Roles can be used to control delivery.
